name: Equius Zahhak
source:
One of the twelve trolls first introduced in Homestuck, the player befriends Equius in Volume 7 of Pesterquest alongside Terezi.

Equius is something of a masochist. He is strict on the adherence to Alternia's hemospectrum, but he also seems to enjoy being told what to do. His home is filled with robots broken from fights.
